newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHARES MIXED IN LIGHT TRADE.
newsitem.headline: SHARES MIXED IN LIGHT TRADE.

text.p: Trading was mixed Wednesday on Lithuania's bourse as investors remained wary, dealers said.
"It is quite a weak market," said Saulius Merkys, a broker with Vilfima.
Turnover on the central market dropped to 630,000 litas from one million litas. Block trade turnover fell to 46,000 litas from 2.4 million litas.
Rokishkis Cheese slumped to 43.00 litas from 44.00 litas in fairly heavy volume of about 200,000 litas.
"Someone is probably trying to support the price at around 43.00 litas," said Merkys.
The Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) inched up to 6.40 litas from 6.39 litas in relatively high trade of 130,000 litas.
"It's a good sign, and it's stable," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema.
Merkys said that LISCO, which fell recently, would probably hold steady.
"Probably it won't go down lower," Merkys said. "It's a good company."
Hermis Bank slid to 175.00 litas from 178.00 litas, but brokers said they expected its shares to rise soon as its first quarter results were very good.
